d: Long, flowing coral-pink hair with straight bangs framing the face and wide, almond-shaped lime-green eyes. An adolescent appearance with a slender build, wearing a black and pink oversized jacket over a short white dress with a black ruffled hem and a brown belt. A large black witch hat with a red underside and a pink bow is worn, complemented by black ankle boots with pink socks. Accessories include a small skull charm on the hat and a large wooden staff adorned with a pink bow, colorful beads, and a small skull.
